Team,

Following up from our 1:1s — we have an opportunity to re-open a senior ML Infrastructure headcount to backfill Karthik's role (REQ-1832). The candidate pipeline currently has a senior-level IC (Daniel Cho) who finished loop interviews yesterday and is green on technical and systems design. Before we proceed to an offer, I need a formal go-ahead on headcount + comp band sign-off.

What I am asking:
- Marissa: confirm budget headcount and whether we should treat this as a true backfill vs. re-scope.
- Vivek: confirm recruiting bandwidth and timeline for two more onsite panels if we want a backfill.
- Laura/Aditya: please review the attached job spec and comp band, and confirm any changes to level/IC vs. lead expectations.

Attached: REQ-1832-job-spec.pdf (candidate-facing JD), comp-band-approval.xlsx (proposed base + equity range).

Tentative timeline: we should aim to decide by end-of-day Monday 2/9 so PeopleOps can prepare offer materials. Daniel is expecting an update next week.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Engineering Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Jordan —
Thanks for the heads up. Quick answers below: 
- Budget: we have the headcount slot as a backfill under Q1 hiring plan; finance has penciled the average comp at band 5 senior IC. The comp band sheet looks OK, though I suggest trimming top-of-band equity for this opening unless you have a compelling reason.
- Re-scope: treat it as a backfill 1:1 unless engineering requests a level change. If you want to promote to a lead, we need to re-open headcount justification.

If we proceed as backfill, PeopleOps can wave the req through once we confirm the total comp and sign-off from hiring manager + Eng VP.

Looping in recruiting context — we have bandwidth to close this quickly if we prioritize the slate. External recruiter Sera Talent (contacted below) already has one vetted candidate (Daniel) and can provide two additional screened candidates within 7–10 business days.

Hiring manager notes from loop: candidate shows strong kernel-level familiarity and scaling experience; hiring panel flagged curiosity on long-term roadmap fit (distributed cache and KV strategies). We recommended a short follow-up system design exercise instead of re-running full loops.

If leadership approves the backfill at band 5 senior IC, I propose: 
1) Issue a verbal hold to Daniel and run the 1-hour design exercise next week.
2) If exercise passes, proceed to comp approval and offer.
